title: "10x flex processing"
output: html_document
date: "2026-09-21"
---


```{r load}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(harmony)
library(UCell)

set.seed(123)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 8000 * 1024^2)

data_dir <- "path/to/data"
out_dir  <- "path/to/output"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

prefix <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")
```

```{r sample sheet}
samples <- data.frame(
  sample      = c("K97_N", "K130_N", "K97_T", "K130_T"),
  patient     = c("K97", "K130", "K97", "K130"),
  tissue_type = c("Normal", "Normal", "Tumor", "Tumor"),
  gem         = c("GEM1", "GEM1", "GEM2", "GEM2")
)
samples$matrix_dir <- file.path(data_dir, samples$sample,
                                "sample_filtered_feature_bc_matrix")
```

```{r load data}
seurat_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(samples)), function(i) {
  s <- samples[i, ]
  obj <- CreateSeuratObject(Read10X(data.dir = s$matrix_dir),
                            project = s$sample,
                            min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
  obj$sample      <- s$sample
  obj$patient     <- s$patient
  obj$tissue_type <- s$tissue_type
  obj$gem         <- s$gem
  obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, pattern = "^MT-")
  obj
})

combined <- merge(seurat_list[[1]],
                  y = seurat_list[-1],
                  add.cell.ids = samples$sample,
                  project = "FlexProject")
rm(seurat_list); gc()

table(combined$sample)
```

```{r qc}
VlnPlot(combined,
        features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),
        group.by = "sample", pt.size = 0.1, ncol = 3)

FeatureScatter(combined, "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt", group.by = "sample") +
  FeatureScatter(combined, "nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA", group.by = "sample")

combined <- subset(combined,
                   subset = nFeature_RNA > 300 &
                            nFeature_RNA < 5000 &
                            percent.mt < 5)

ncol(combined)
```

```{r remove doublets}
# Convert to SingleCellExperiment
sce.combined <- JoinLayers(combined)
sce.combined <- as.SingleCellExperiment(sce.combined, assay = "RNA")

# Compute doublets
set.seed(10010101)
sce <- scDblFinder(sce.combined,
                   clusters=T,
                   samples=sce.combined$gem, 
                   multiSampleMode="split", 
                   dims=30,
                   includePCs=1:30, 
                   verbose=TRUE) 

combined$doublet_score <- sce$scDblFinder.score
combined$doublet_class <- sce$scDblFinder.class

# Filter out doublets AND low-quality cells
combined <- subset(combined, subset = doublet_class == "singlet" & 
                                       nFeature_RNA > 200 & 
                                       nFeature_RNA < 5000 & 
                                       percent.mt < 10)

## cell cycle regression
s.genes <- c(cc.genes.updated.2019$s.genes)
g2m.genes <- c(cc.genes.updated.2019$g2m.genes)
combined <- CellCycleScoring(combined, s.features = s.genes, g2m.features = g2m.genes)

combined <- ScaleData(combined, vars.to.regress = c("S.Score", "G2M.Score")) 
combined <- RunPCA(combined)
combined <- RunUMAP(combined, dims = 1:30)
combined <- FindNeighbors(combined, dims = 1:30)
combined <- FindClusters(combined, resolution = 0.5)
```


```{r harmony integration}
combined <- combined %>%
  NormalizeData() %>%
  FindVariableFeatures() %>%
  ScaleData() %>%
  RunPCA()

combined <- RunHarmony(combined, group.by.vars = "gem", reduction.use = "pca")

combined <- combined %>%
  FindNeighbors(reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.5) %>%
  RunUMAP(reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30)

saveRDS(combined, file.path(out_dir, "harmony_integrated.rds"))
```

```{r umaps}
for (var in c("tissue_type", "sample", "patient", "gem")) {
  DimPlot(combined, reduction = "umap", group.by = var)
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(prefix, "_UMAP_", var, ".pdf")),
         height = 6, width = 8)
}
```
